AccessClass TBase_Team
	Import GameData.data_baseteam

	Static MatchHomeTeam
		Return TMatch.team1
	EndFinder

	Static MatchAwayTeam
		Return TMatch.team2
	EndFinder

	String name
	String shortname
	String tla

	Int kitstylehome
	String colshirthome1
	String colshirthome2
	String colshirtaway1
	String colshirtaway2
EndAccess





AccessClass TPlayer
	Import GameControllers.class_player

	Static Player
		Return player
	EndFinder

	Float scoutcount Return Int(inst.HasScout())
	Float physiocount Return Int(inst.HasPhysio())
	Float marketingManagerBonus Return Float(inst.marketingManagerBonus)
	Float marketingManagerDuration Return Float(inst.marketingManagerDuration)
	Float shareholderPercentage
	
	Float weatherSeason Return Int(inst.GetWeatherSeason())
EndAccess

AccessClass TPlayerGlobal TPlayerClass
	Import GameControllers.class_player
	
	Float languageId Return TPlayer.opLanguage
	String RandomTip Return TPlayer.GetRandomTip
	Float rewardedAdsEnabled Return TPlayer.rewardedAdsEnabled
EndAccess



AccessClass TClub
	Import GameData.data_club

	Finder Club
		Return TClub.SelectById(key.AsFloat())
	EndFinder

	String form Return inst.GetStringForm()
	Float strength

	String colshirthome1
	String colshirthome2
	String colshirtaway1
	String colshirtaway2

EndAccess

AccessClass TFootball
	Import GameControllers.Match.class_matchfootball
	
	Static activeball
		Return activeball
	EndFinder
	
	Float x
	Float y
	Float z
EndAccess

AccessClass TMatchPlayer
	Import GameControllers.Match.class_matchplayer
	
	Static ballcontroller
		If (activeball)
			Return activeball.controlledby
		Else
			Return Null
		EndIf
	EndFinder
	
	Finder TMatchPlayerFromId
		If (TMatchPlayer.gstack <> Null)
			Return TMatchPlayer.SelectById(Int(key.AsFloat()))
		Else
			Return Null
		EndIf	
	EndFinder
	
	Float x
	Float y
	Float z
EndAccess


AccessClass GelDrawCached
	Import guiscript.Gels.geldrawcached
	Static DrawCached
		return GelDrawCached(QGR_Current.ref)
	EndFinder

	Float Dirty return Int(inst.source = Null or inst.source.cleanKey <> inst.cleanKey)

EndAccess
